newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders most financial bodies out of stocks.
newsitem.headline: China orders most financial bodies out of stocks.

text.p: China's central bank has ordered the closure of all securities offices except those run by trust and investment companies and securities firms in order to help regulate the industry, a newspaper said on Sunday.

The securities trading offices run by commercial banks, insurance companies and other firms must close by the end of this year, the Shanghai Securities News said, quoting a recent notice by the People's Bank of China.

China currently has about 1,700 securities offices, mainly set up during the stock fever of the early 1990s. A large preportion have since become money-losers and suffered irregularities due to poor managment and loose supervision, analysts said.
